extra:cap.desc: a man at the fruit stall

briefing-at-the-screens.1.1.line: {desk-sergeant} stands at the front screens before the morning briefing.

briefing-at-the-screens.1.2.line: {framed-officer} reads the patrol rota on the screen, then reads it again.

briefing-at-the-screens.1.3.line: {desk-sergeant} points at one line of the rota: "Corner 7, 22:00, once a week."

briefing-at-the-screens.1.4.line: {inside-officer} and {framed-officer} walk out of the station together for the day shift.

corner-scan-at-the-pond.1.1.line: {veteran-officer} and {rookie-officer} walk the north path around the koi pond.

corner-scan-at-the-pond.1.2.line: {rookie-officer} scans corner 3 with the handheld, arm held out straight.

corner-scan-at-the-pond.1.3.line: {veteran-officer} stands at the pond rail, lips moving without a sound.

corner-scan-at-the-pond.1.4.line: {veteran-officer} turns to {rookie-officer} and says one word: "Again."

night-round-on-the-highway.1.1.line: {family-caller-officer} and {night-stakeout-officer} walk the night round along the sky highway.

night-round-on-the-highway.1.2.line: Comm, one side, {family-caller-officer}, a few steps behind: "Not now, Mama."

night-round-on-the-highway.1.3.line: {night-stakeout-officer} stands at the east rail, looking down over the city.

night-round-on-the-highway.1.4.line: {night-stakeout-officer} scans one door along the highway and none of the others.

scan-skipped-at-corner-3.1.1.line: {burnout-officer} walks past corner 3 without raising the scanner.

scan-skipped-at-corner-3.1.2.line: {burnout-officer} sits on a seat in the square and stays there for twenty-five minutes.

scan-skipped-at-corner-3.1.3.line: {burnout-officer} looks at the scan slate: the corner 3 line is empty.

scan-skipped-at-corner-3.1.4.line: {burnout-officer} shrugs at the scan slate and tucks it away.

umbrellas-at-the-plaza.1.1.line: {ow-umbrella-seller} stands under the plaza awning beside a rack of folded umbrellas.

umbrellas-at-the-plaza.1.2.line: {ow-umbrella-seller} hands {rookie-officer} an umbrella with a numbered paper tag on the handle.

umbrellas-at-the-plaza.1.3.line: {rookie-officer} shares the umbrella with {extra:passerby} along the path to the koi pond.

umbrellas-at-the-plaza.1.4.line: {rookie-officer} bumps into a queue, and {rookie-officer.his} notebook drops onto the wet stones.

bag-grab-at-the-lift.1.1.line: {ow-glove-thief} bumps hard into {extra:victim} by the lift doors.

bag-grab-at-the-lift.1.2.line: {ow-glove-thief} snatches up {extra:victim}'s bag from the floor.

bag-grab-at-the-lift.1.3.line: {ow-glove-thief} runs through the lobby, and one green glove drops behind {ow-glove-thief.him}.

bag-grab-at-the-lift.1.5.line: {veteran-officer} picks up the green glove, red stitches running across the fingers.

fruit-and-a-limp.1.1.line: {extra:cap} stands at a fruit stall counter, looking over the trays.

fruit-and-a-limp.1.2.line: {extra:cap} lifts a bag of fruit from the counter, and no coins go down.

fruit-and-a-limp.1.3.line: {extra:cap} walks toward the stairs with the bag, left foot dragging.

hood-at-the-shutter.1.1.line: {ow-hood-waiter} stands at a shopfront shutter in the rain for forty minutes.

hood-at-the-shutter.1.2.line: {night-stakeout-officer} stands across the lane, watching {ow-hood-waiter} at the shutter.

hood-at-the-shutter.1.3.line: {ow-hood-waiter} leaves the shutter late in the night, hands in pockets.

hood-at-the-shutter.1.4.line: {night-stakeout-officer} walks home the long way, by the last block.

two-cups-at-the-counter.1.1.line: {framed-officer} sits at the food counter with a paper notebook open.

two-cups-at-the-counter.1.2.line: {inside-officer} eats a bowl at the counter beside {framed-officer}.

two-cups-at-the-counter.1.3.line: {extra:counter-hand} slides two cups across the counter to {framed-officer} and {inside-officer}.

two-cups-at-the-counter.1.5.line: The receipt reads "13:07," and {framed-officer} tucks it into the notebook.

the-regular-seat.1.1.line: {veteran-officer} sits in {veteran-officer.his} usual seat at the food counter.

the-regular-seat.1.2.line: {veteran-officer} eats the same meal from the same bowl as last time.

the-regular-seat.1.3.line: {rookie-officer} reads the notices pinned to the board by the door.

the-regular-seat.1.4.line: {ow-hood-waiter} comes in out of the rain, shaking water off {ow-hood-waiter.his} sleeves.

the-regular-seat.1.6.line: {extra:friend} says to {ow-hood-waiter}: "You stood forty minutes in the rain?"

takeaway-run.1.1.line: {family-caller-officer} leaves the stakeout post, and {night-stakeout-officer} stays on it alone.

takeaway-run.1.2.line: {family-caller-officer} steps up to the night food counter.

takeaway-run.1.3.line: {extra:counter-hand} hands {family-caller-officer} a paper bag of takeaway.

takeaway-run.1.4.line: {family-caller-officer} reads the receipt, stamped "02:14," and pockets it.

takeaway-run.1.5.line: {family-caller-officer} walks back along the lane with the paper bag.

umbrellas-on-the-highway.1.1.line: {inside-officer} and {framed-officer} share one umbrella along the sky highway.

umbrellas-on-the-highway.1.2.line: {framed-officer} reads a paper tag on an umbrella hooked over the rail: "4471."

umbrellas-on-the-highway.1.3.line: {burnout-officer} sits on the rail bench in the rain, a taped paper bag on {burnout-officer.his} knee.

umbrellas-on-the-highway.1.4.line: {burnout-officer} leaves the bench with the bag tucked under one arm.

glove-again.1.1.line: {ow-glove-thief} walks into the lift hall, a green glove with red stitches showing at one pocket.

glove-again.1.2.line: {ow-glove-thief} bumps into {extra:victim} near the lift doors.

glove-again.1.3.line: {ow-glove-thief} lifts {extra:victim}'s bag and does not run.

corner-3-scanned.1.1.line: {burnout-officer} stops at corner 3 and scans it with the handheld.

corner-3-scanned.1.2.line: {burnout-officer} stands at corner 3 for three minutes, looking up and down the lanes.

corner-3-scanned.1.3.line: {desk-sergeant} reads the scan slate: the corner 3 line is filled in.

corner-3-scanned.1.4.line: {desk-sergeant} points at the corner 3 line on the slate.

fruit-stall-again.1.1.line: {extra:cap}, limping, lifts a bag of fruit from a stall counter.

fruit-stall-again.1.3.line: {rookie-officer} arrests {extra:cap} at the foot of the stairs.

fruit-stall-again.1.4.line: {burnout-officer} sits on the bench by the fruit stall with a taped paper bag.

fruit-stall-again.1.5.line: {burnout-officer} opens the taped paper bag and eats the sandwich inside.

quiet-week-at-the-screens.1.1.line: {desk-sergeant} posts a new patrol rota to the station screens.

quiet-week-at-the-screens.1.2.line: {desk-sergeant} points at the new rota line: "Corner 7, twice a week."

quiet-week-at-the-screens.1.5.line: {extra:tag-finder} hands {desk-sergeant} a paper umbrella tag numbered "4471."
